IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ResponsibilityRuleResultAsset') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[ResponsibilityRuleResultAsset]( [RuleID] [bigint] NOT NULL, [AssetID] [bigint] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [AssetTypeID] [int] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NOT NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ResponsibilityRuleResultAsset] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [RuleID] ASC, [AssetID] ASC, [AssetTypeID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ResonsibilityRuleResultAsset_AssetTypeID-AssetID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ResonsibilityRuleResultAsset_AssetTypeID-AssetID] ON [dbo].[ResponsibilityRuleResultAsset] ( [AssetTypeID] ASC, [AssetID] ASC ) END

changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ResponsibilityRuleResultAsset_AssetID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_ResponsibilityRuleResultAsset_AssetID ON [dbo].[ResponsibilityRuleResultAsset] ( [AssetID] ASC ) END
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ResponsibilityRuleResultAsset_AssetID') BEGIN DROP INDEX IX_ResponsibilityRuleResultAsset_AssetID ON [dbo].[ResponsibilityRuleResultAsset] END
